title: Remove Detail Tree Label Gap in Sketchpad Panel
description: Remove the empty spacer before detail panel tree labels like Name, Description, Connection, Authors, and Attributes in the sketchpad details panel by fixing the shared tree label layout. Update existing tests to cover the label tree layout behavior and verify the affected UI package tests pass.
